name: Put working muscle where the scar is
description: Replace infarct scar with contractile cardiomyocytes that are aligned with the host muscle and contribute to the pump.

grade.note: Human pluripotent-derived cardiomyocytes remuscularised infarcted non-human primate hearts and improved contractile function (Chong 2014, Liu 2018, Romagnuolo 2019, three reports from overlapping Seattle groups). The grafts are real muscle and they beat with the host — and every one of these studies reports ventricular arrhythmia. Human evidence is limited to a small epicardial patch trial with no efficacy conclusion (Menasché 2018).

wouldMove: A large-animal remuscularisation study without sustained arrhythmia, then a first-in-human injection or patch trial with a contractile endpoint.
